headline: France sends evacuees home as wildfires flare across Europe
summary: Cooler weather helped southwest France, but fires continued in Spain, Greece and elsewhere after mass evacuations across the region.
script: France allowed eighty-four thousand evacuees to return as crews contained parts of a major southwest wildfire. But fires still burned across Spain, Britain, Germany, Greece and Turkey. At the peak, a third of a million people fled France and Spain.
imageAlt: A firefighter carries equipment through a wildfire near Blagon, France.
